decision: Deletion of lap time (1:17.488) as per Article 31.4 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
event_name: Document 25 Date 27 October 2018 Time 14:01 2018 MEXICAN GRAND PRIX 25 - 28 October 2018 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Car 14 left the track at turn 11.
offence: Breach of Article 27.3 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
penalty: Deletion of lap time (1:17.488) as per Article 31.4 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: Car 14 left the track in turn 11 by crossing the kerb on the exit of the turn, with no part of the car remaining in contact with the red and white section of the kerb (item 10.1 of Race Director's Event Notes, (document 18). By doing that, car 14 was deemed to have gained an advantage.
rules_referenced: Article 27.3 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
Article 31.4 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Doc 25 2018 Mexican Grand Prix Offence Car 14 Leaving The Track At Turn 11
